Subject: Mid-month seat add + entity split — need interim invoice and VAT guidance

Hi Priya,

Quick one from our side: we bumped 12 seats (team X) mid-cycle on 2026-03-03 and reallocated 6 of those seats to our EU entity (ThermaLabs GmbH) for compliance. Our AP queue pulled the new invoice and it shows the full 12-seat charge under the US entity.

Two asks: can you (1) issue an interim/proforma that splits the prorated charge between ThermaLabs, Inc. (US) and ThermaLabs GmbH (DE) so our EU AP can book the VAT reverse-charge correctly; and (2) confirm whether Redwood will apply the pro-rata only for the remainder of this billing period or back-date to the 3/3 activation date. We need the VAT-bearing line items and a short justification for our auditors.

We’re happy to pay the outstanding amount but AP requested a 30-day payment plan for the EU portion while they complete entity invoicing. Please advise next steps and any docs you need (we can attach VAT certs).

Thanks,
Elena

Hi Elena — thanks for the heads up and congrats on the product rollout. Short answers first: we prorate from the activation date (3/3) for usage-based seats; and we can issue a split interim/proforma that separates the EU and US charge lines and includes VAT notes for reverse-charge.

I’ve attached a proforma that (a) quantifies the prorated token/seat charge for the remainder of your billing period, (b) shows two invoice lines (ThermaLabs, Inc. — net, and ThermaLabs GmbH — gross with VAT meta for reverse-charge), and (c) includes the accounting justification you can share with auditors.

On the payment plan: we’re open to a 30-day deferral for the EU portion provided we get a signed payment plan amendment and your VAT certificate for the German entity. I’ve copied Ben from account exec so he can confirm commercial approvals; I’ll loop Finance for the actual invoice routing.

Next steps I propose:
- Elena: confirm VAT certificate and preferred invoice recipient emails for both entities (attach VAT cert)
- Ben: confirm whether we offer any one-time credit for the administrative split (we typically don’t, but may consider a minor adjustment for large multi-entity accounts)
- Finance (cc to follow): prepare split interim invoice and attach DocuSign amendment for the 30-day plan

I’ll follow up after Ben and Finance chime in.

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Account Manager, Redwood Inference
